messages:
oncall-bot: [ALERT] Canary health deviation for service=inference-api commit=abc123 (v1.4.2). 5m error rate=4.6% (threshold 2%). -> paging @devon oncall :rotating_light:
jamie: @devon got the page, I'm in the channel. any visible customer impact?
devon: seeing increased 5xx from canary hosts, latency up ~80ms p95. No paged customers yet but spike matches canary rollout window.
sasha: deploy-bot shows canary rollout at 15% and automated rollback policy is ENABLED. looks like it tried to initiate rollback but status=stuck.
deploy-bot: automated-rollback triggered at 1866667800 but drain-step failed on host inference-canary-3 (session-affinity).
marta: note — that host has a long-lived websocket test harness; might be preventing graceful drain.
ryan: can we flip the feature-flag kill-switch to divert traffic away from the canary while we diagnose? flag=rollout_inference_v1_4_2 -> OFF will route to stable by rule-set.
devon: do it. I'm going to try a manual drain for inference-canary-3 in parallel.
kim: flipping flag now: `ff toggle rollout_inference_v1_4_2 OFF` -> executed by kim at 1866667850 :white_check_mark:
jamie: seeing instantaneous drop in canary traffic to <1% from 15%. error rate on overall cluster trending down. good so far.
sasha: automated-rollback still shows stuck because deploy agent couldn't SSH to inference-canary-3 during drain. we'll clear that alarm and then trigger manual rollback.
devon: manual drain attempt: `kubectl drain inference-canary-3 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --timeout=60s` -> failing due to PID stuck in process `test-harness`. killing process now.
ryan: killed harness, drain progressing.
devon: initiating manual rollback: `deploy rollback --service inference-api --to-version v1.4.1 --mode manual` at 1866667930. deploy-bot: acknowledged.
deploy-bot: rollback started, controlling traffic shift: 15% -> 0% over 60s, removing canary hosts after shift.
marta: monitoring health endpoints and smoke checks: `curl -f https://inference.api/health` -> 200 OK on stable pools.
jamie: starting smoke load (50rps) against canary region to verify no regression post-rollback.
kim: quick customer impact note: support queue saw 3 reports of transient 500s starting at rollout window, ticket severity P2. Escalated to SEs.
sasha: metrics look stable now: error rate back to baseline ~0.4%, p95 latency down to expected.
devon: post-rollback verification checklist:
- confirm all canary pods terminated -> `kubectl get pods -l roll=canary` shows 0.
- run end-to-end sample prompt through inference to validate outputs -> success 10/10.
- check logs for repeat errors on stable -> none since flag flip.
(verification done at 1866668005)
jamie: marking incident as mitigated, but leaving channel open for postmortem notes. please add any action items.
ryan: action item: add selector to test-harness so it respects drain signals; follow-up PR assigned to @marta.
marta: ack, will open PR and include a kill-switch gate to avoid long-lived processes during rollout.
sasha: also suggest we tune automated-rollback drain timeout from 30s -> 120s for this service (sticky sessions exist).
devon: agreed. I'll schedule a config change behind a feature flag and run a dry-run in staging.
kim: customer communication: posting short note to support that issue was limited to canary and rollback completed, link to incident once postmortem draft is ready.
jamie: thanks all — closing channel in 30m unless we see new alerts. :thumbsup:
